Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the demo last week — procurement asked me to push the attached redlines to the DPA and get a read on how Redwood wants to handle international transfers. High-level items from legal:

- ZenBridge has a requirement to see the Subprocessor list and KMS boundaries in writing before signature.
- We prefer SCCs (EU Standard Contractual Clauses) with a short Transfer Impact Addendum where applicable; we’ve flagged two EU->US processing paths.
- A couple of MSA/order-form-linked clauses need alignment (data retention, deletion confirmation window — they want 30 days max).

Attached: zenbridge_dpa_redlines_20270711.docx (word doc: DPA with tracked changes). Procurement would like a mutual action plan and an estimated signoff timeline (they’re targeting EoM July). Can you confirm who on your side is the point for legal + security for evidence (SOC2, subprocessor list, KMS)?

Thanks,
Sophie

Hi Sophie — thanks for sending and for the clear redlines. Looping in Ben (Privacy & Contracts) and Laura (Legal Ops) to triage.

Quick sync / asks from our side so we can provide a consolidated response by mid-week:

1) Evidence point-of-contact: Ben will own the SOC2 / subprocessor evidence handoff. He will share a sanitized subprocessor list and KMS boundaries we commit to for the ZenBridge tenant.
2) Transfer approach: we typically offer SCCs + Transfer Impact Assessment for EU accounts that need US-hosted compute. If the customer requires on-prem or EU-only hosting we can discuss a Private deployment quote (separate OOF).
3) Retention / deletion: the 30-day deletion confirmation is within our typical SLA for hosted API customers, but we need to confirm Order Form language to lock it in.

Proposed next steps:
- Ben to reply with evidence checklist and an initial ETA for subprocessor list (by Tue EOD).
- Laura to propose redline suggestions for retention wording we can accept (target Wed).
- I’ll produce a short mutual action plan and timeline and share DocuSign-ready order form language (target Thu).

I’ve attached an internal evidence checklist to speed Ben up: rwdw-dpa-evidence-checklist.pdf (pdf stub).

Regards,
Mateo Alvarez

Thanks for the heads up. Quick notes from Security/Privacy:

- Evidence: SOC2 Type II report (latest), processed/sanitized subprocessor list, and a KMS boundary statement will be provided. I’ll send the subprocessor spreadsheet and the KMS note by EOD Tue (12 Jul).
- Transfer mechanism: Recommended path is SCCs + TIA (Transfer Impact Assessment). We can prepare an annex (Transfer Addendum) that maps the two processing paths you flagged and includes compensating safeguards (encryption-in-transit & at-rest, access control).
- Retention / deletion: We can commit to Order Form language: "Data subject to deletion will be removed from active systems within 7 days and fully purged from backups within 30 days". Laura — can you draft the exact clause that matches our deletion pipeline?
